task_instance: Load a small sample CSV/Parquet dataset into cuDF and run a groupby + merge (per Path 2 of the skill: `cudf.read_parquet`, `df.groupby(...).sum()`, `df.merge(...)`), i.e. the skill's core deliverable of GPU-accelerated DataFrame ETL.
blocker_detail: The skill's entire purpose is GPU-accelerated DataFrames via NVIDIA's cuDF library, which requires (a) an NVIDIA GPU and CUDA driver/toolkit, and (b) the `cudf`/`cudf.pandas`/`dask_cudf` Python packages. This workstation has no NVIDIA GPU (`nvidia-smi` is not installed/found) and the `cudf` module is not installed (`ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'cudf'`). Installing cuDF requires conda/pip from NVIDIA's package channels, which needs network access that is unavailable (air-gapped, no installs allowed). Running the equivalent operations in plain pandas would not exercise or verify the skill's actual claim (GPU acceleration, cudf.pandas fallback profiling, nullable-dtype/GPU-CPU parity semantics specific to cuDF), so the core deliverable cannot be produced or verified here.
